title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Human Rights and Discrimination
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A paralegal who runs their own firm refuses to hire an administrative assistant because the applicant wears a religious head covering. Does this violate the Paralegal Rules of Conduct?
options: No, because the Rules of Conduct only apply to client interactions, not employment practices.
Yes, Rule 2.03 strictly requires paralegals to respect the requirements of human rights laws and prohibits discrimination in all aspects of professional practice, including employment.
No, private firm owners have total discretion over hiring practices.
Yes, but it is only a violation if the paralegal states the reason out loud to the applicant.
questions.explain: Rule 2.03 (Harassment and Discrimination) states that a paralegal must respect the requirements of human rights laws in force in Ontario and shall not discriminate on grounds such as race, ancestry, religion, sex, etc. This obligation extends to employment practices within the law firm.
